BOOK ONE · LESSON 095

Tickets, please.

请把车票拿出来。

A dialogue lesson on 'had better' and 'must'. George and Ken buy two return tickets to London and ask about the next train, which leaves at eight nineteen from Platform Two. Thinking they have plenty of time, they go to a bar next door to the station for a drink. When they return, the porter tells them they have just missed the train — the bar's clock was ten minutes slow, and the next train is not until five hours later. New vocabulary includes return, train, platform, plenty, bar, station, porter, catch, and miss. Workbook practice covers completing the dialogue (fill in missing words) and choosing the correct word. Grammar exercises practise giving replies with 'had better', writing sentences with 'must', and rewriting 'a lot of' as 'plenty of'.

Listen then answer this question. Why did George and Ken miss the train?
听录音，然后回答问题。为什么乔治和肯误了火车？

Listen to the recording and answer the question: Why did George and Ken miss the train?

  1. 1

    GEORGE

    Two return tickets to London, please.
    What time will the next train leave?

    乔治：买两张到伦敦的往返票。下一班火车什么时候开？

  2. 2

    ATTENDANT

    At nineteen minutes past eight.

    售票员：8点19分。

  3. 3

    GEORGE

    Which platform?

    乔治：在哪个站台？

  4. 4

    ATTENDANT

    Platform Two.
    Over the bridge.

    售票员：2号站台。过天桥。

  5. 5

    KEN

    What time will the next train leave?

    肯：下一班火车什么时候开？

  6. 6

    GEORGE

    At eight nineteen.

    乔治：8点19分。

  7. 7

    KEN

    We've got plenty of time.

    肯：我们的时间还很充裕。

  8. 8

    GEORGE

    It's only three minutes to eight.

    乔治：现在才7点57分。

  9. 9

    KEN

    Let's go and have a drink.
    There's a bar
    next door to the station.

    肯：让我们去喝点东西吧，车站旁有一个酒吧。

  10. 10

    GEORGE

    We had better
    go back to the station now, Ken.

    乔治：肯，我们现在最好回到车站去。

  11. 11

    PORTER

    Tickets, please.

    乘务员：请出示车票。

  12. 12

    GEORGE

    We want to catch
    the eight nineteen to London.

    乔治：我们要乘8点19分的车去伦敦。

  13. 13

    PORTER

    You've just missed it!

    乘务员：你们刚好错过了那班车。

  14. 14

    GEORGE

    What!

    乔治：什么！

  15. 15

    PORTER

    It's only eight fifteen.
    I'm sorry, sir.

    乘务员：现在只有8点15分。对不起，先生。

  16. 16

    GEORGE

    That clock's ten minutes slow.
    When's the next train?

    乔治：那个钟慢了10分钟。下一班车是什么时候？

  17. 17

    PORTER

    In five hours' time!

    乘务员：5个小时以后！

n. 往返
train /treɪn/
n. 火车
platform /ˈplætfɔːm/
n. 站台
plenty /ˈplenti/
n. 大量
bar /bɑː(r)/
n. 酒吧
station /ˈsteɪʃn/
n. 车站，火车站

n. 乘务员

v. 赶上

Notes on the text 课文注释

return ticket

return ticket, 往返票。

next door to ...

next door to ..., 与……相邻，在……隔壁。

had better

had better 相当于情态动词，当"最好"讲，用于指现在和将要做的事情。各种人称后面的形式相同，简写作 'd better。后面接动词原形。

catch the eight nineteen to London

catch the eight nineteen to London, 这里的 eight nineteen 是指 8 点 19 分的火车，to London 是表示火车的行车方向。

in five hours' time

in five hours' time, 5 小时之后。这里的介词 in 是"在……之后"的意思，复数名词 hours 后面用所有格，直接加表示所有格的撇号就可以，不必再加 s。
